author: KiraTV
description:
With the advancement and availability of AI tools, the landscape of information has changed. For as little as 20 dollars a month you can create entirely new people, in picture, video and audio. This has terrifying ramifications for what people believe to be real, and when applied to the ever changing landscape of cybercrime, fraud and scams, the end result is worrying. Scammers have always been limited in their pursuit by what they can make you believe. But now, most people cannot tell what is real and what isn't. Flattening the curve for who can fall victim to fraud and exploitation.
